OnPlay.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<EnergyNextTurnPower>(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, DynamicVars.Energy.IntValue, Owner.Creature, this)` (Outmaneuver.cs:28) == `PowerCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, EnergyNextTurnPower, self._energy, applier=ctx.player)`. The energy is NOT gained now on either side -- the power grants it next turn. Presentation, folded in: the energy hover tip (15).
